description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents…“Beachwalk”, where relaxation meets adventure! Just steps from the exclusive WaterColor Beach Club and the serenity of Cerulean Park, this inviting getaway captures the magic of 30A. Cruise on 4 included bikes, soak up the Seaside charm, or float your cares away at the Camp District Lazy River. Whether it’s family bonding or a friend’s escape, this pet-friendly retreat promises unforgettable moments and all the laid-back vibes you crave. Ready to unwind? Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***A quick 2-minute bike ride to the WaterColor Beach Club and Cerulean Park – Feel the ocean breeze as you glide to the vibrant heart of relaxation and natural beauty. Pet-Friendly Paradise — Bring your furry friend along for the adventure—perfect for tail-wagging strolls and shaded porch naps.Only 5 minutes to the Camp District Lazy River – Dive into laid-back fun and family-friendly vibes at this serene retreat.Discover Seaside’s iconic shops, dining, and Grayton Beach State Park – Immerse yourself in coastal charm, delicious cuisine, and breathtaking outdoor adventures.Includes 4 bikes for your convenience – Explore the area effortlessly and soak up the carefree beach-town atmosphere.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "The location was so convenient. We loved being so close to the beach club and the bikes made everything super easy!" – Lauren ⭐ "Such a beautiful spot! Everything was clean, cozy, and perfectly located near great attractions like Seaside." – Alex ⭐ "Perfect getaway for the family. We enjoyed riding the bikes and spending time at the lazy river. Highly recommend!" – Jamie*** LIVING AREA ***Step into the cozy elegance of the living area at “Beachwalk”, where every detail is designed for ultimate relaxation. Bathed in natural light, this open, airy space exudes a tranquil vibe perfect for making cherished family memories. The interiors are thoughtfully curated, blending breezy coastal charm with sleek modern amenities, creating a harmonious balance of comfort and style.Spacious open-concept living area with cozy seating, a Smart TV, and modern decorLarge windows fill the space with natural light, creating a bright and airy atmospherePerfect for relaxation, movie nights, or entertaining guests in styleHigh-speed Wi-Fi and streaming-ready TV for ultimate convenienceThoughtfully designed layout to maximize comfort and functionality*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The fully-equipped kitchen is a chef's dream, providing everything you need to create delicious meals during your stay. Featuring spacious countertops, state-of-the-art appliances, and a cozy, adjacent dining area, this inviting space is designed to make cooking and sharing meals effortless and enjoyable for everyone.Sleek, modern kitchen with stainless steel appliances, ample storage, and elegant finishesSpacious dining table comfortably seating 6, perfect for family meals or entertaining guestsOpen-concept layout for seamless flow between kitchen and dining areasStylish lighting fixtures to create the perfect ambianceDurable, easy-to-clean surfaces designed for everyday convenience*** OUTDOOR COMMUNITY AMENITIES ***Experience the ultimate WaterColor getaway, where lush landscapes like Cerulean Park meet the luxury of the beach club and the family-friendly charm of the Camp District Lazy River. Cruise through scenic trails by bike, unwind by the sparkling waters, and bask in the beauty of 30A’s endless sunshine. Your perfect escape awaits!Just steps away from Cerulean Park and the exclusive WaterColor Beach Club, perfect for relaxation and sun-soaked daysConvenient bike access to nearby attractions, including charming shops, local restaurants, and scenic trailsA quick ride to the Lazy River, a family favorite for endless fun and relaxationSurrounded by stunning natural beauty, including lush greenery and pristine beachesAccess to a variety of outdoor activities, such as paddleboarding, kayaking, and nature walks*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***With thoughtfully designed sleeping arrangements across two floors, this home offers comfort, privacy and functionality for every guest.1st Floor:Primary Queen Suite: Queen bed, flat-screen TV, access to enclosed porch, oversized walk-in closet and En-suite with dual vanities, walk-in shower and soaking tub.King Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with dual vanities and walk-in shower.2nd Floor:Half Bath: Conveniently located off the kitchenBunk Room: Full over full bunk plus twin bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with dual vanities and shower/tub combo, perfect space for kids.*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Nestled in the heart of WaterColor, this stunning vacation rental combines unbeatable convenience with natural beauty. Spend your days unwinding at the luxurious WaterColor Beach Club, just steps away, or explore the pristine trails and breathtaking scenery of Grayton Beach State Park. With endless opportunities for relaxation, adventure, and coastal charm, this location promises an unforgettable getaway.WaterColor Beach Club (2 minutes by bike) – Relax in luxury at this exclusive beachside retreat, perfect for unwinding with ocean views and upscale amenities.Camp District Lazy River (5 minutes by bike) – A family-friendly oasis where you can float the day away in a peaceful, laid-back setting.Seaside Shops and Restaurants (5 minutes by bike) – Enjoy the charm of this vibrant coastal village, filled with unique boutiques, delicious dining, and a lively atmosphere.Grayton Beach State Park (7-minute drive) – Escape into nature at this serene park, offering pristine beaches, hiking trails, and breathtaking sunsets.*** PET-FRIENDLY ***Pets are not allowed on furniture, beds, or in the poolDogs must be crated when left unattended by guestsNon-refundable pet fee: $250 + tax*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to the 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.There are active Ring cameras at the entrance door of the home, at the side porch by the driveway and overlooking the driveway.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***
